raw:
@q query
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "be the medical director of"
    role subject ?x
    role object "Spitalului Clinic Județean de Urgență Sibiu"
    role time "August"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@a1 assumed
  relation "resign from"
  role subject "dr. Bârsan-Oprea"
  role object "Spitalului Clinic Județean de Urgență Sibiu"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature
